preconditions.description: The number of servers n is between 3 and 105, inclusive.
The number of direct connections m is between 0 and 105, inclusive.
The index of the server v that fails is between 1 and n, inclusive.

postconditions.expression: output == -1 or (1 <= len(output) <= m and all(len(conn) == 2 and 1 <= conn[0] < conn[1] <= n for conn in output))
postconditions.description: The output is either -1 or a list of m direct connections, each described by a pair of server indices, where each index is between 1 and n, and the connections are unique and ordered.

postconditions.expression: output == -1 or (v not in [conn[0] for conn in output] and v not in [conn[1] for conn in output])
postconditions.description: The server with index v is not part of any direct connection in the output.

postconditions.expression: output == -1 or (all(all(conn[0] in [conn2[1] for conn2 in output if conn2 != conn] for conn2 in output if conn2 != conn) and all(conn[1] in [conn2[0] for conn2 in output if conn2 != conn] for conn2 in output if conn2 != conn) for conn in output))
postconditions.description: All direct connections are valid and each server is connected to at least one other server.

postconditions.expression: output == -1 or (not any(all(conn[0] not in [conn2[0] for conn2 in output if conn2 != conn] and all(conn[1] not in [conn2[1] for conn2 in output if conn2 != conn]) for conn2 in output if conn2 != conn) for conn in output))
postconditions.description: If the output is not -1, there exists a way to connect the servers such that the server with index v fails, leading to the failure of the whole system.
